subject: general
question: The formation of 'Ward Committees' in the area of a municipality is required under the Indian Constitution. The population of such a municipality should be _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three lakhs or more**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Ward Committees:**

__
 
• Ward is an area in a metro or local municipality, which has clearly defined boundaries.
 
• 74th constitutional amendment act 1992, added Articles 243P to 243ZG related to the Municipalties.
 
• **Article 243S **deals with the constitution and composition of ward committees.
 
• It consists of one or more wards, within the territorial area of a Municipality having a population of three lacs or more. **Hence, option 4 is the correct answer.**
 
• It is a **democratically elected body.**
 
• Important link between the municipality and residents.
